snapshot.name: Eternal Ltd
snapshot.about: Incorporated in 2010, Eternal Limited (previously Zomato Limited) is one of the leading online Food Service platforms in terms of the value of food sold. Its offerings include food delivery, dining-out services, Loyalty programs, and others. As of December 31, 2020, Eternal has established a strong footprint across 23 countries with 131,233 active food delivery restaurants, 161,637 active delivery partners, and an average monthly food order of 10.7 million customers. [1]

narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Margins are expected to expand or reach 5-6% over the long term.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Operating profit margins remain low, fluctuating between 1.2% and 4.7%.

promises.credibility: Management provides ambitious long-term growth and margin targets, but reported operating margins remain subdued compared to the positive long-term narrative.

bull: Revenue growth is accelerating strongly, showing a 97% CAGR over 3 years compared to 94% over 5 years.
The latest quarter in Sep 2026 showed massive improvement with revenue up 78% YoY and EBITDA up 215%.
The company's substantial investments of ₹14,662 Cr significantly exceed its total borrowings of ₹5,757 Cr.
bear: Return on capital employed remains extremely low at 2.48% alongside a weak ROE of 0.94%.
Free cash flow has been deeply negative at ₹-2,988 Cr over the last 5 years, staying negative in 4 of 5 years.
Working capital is noticeably stretching as the cash conversion cycle worsened from -77 to 2 days.
